Hextris — pinned upstream
=========================

repo    https://github.com/Hextris/hextris
branch  gh-pages
commit  3f4847dc8fd7dab3d1c87e6324b9159d92fbd396
date    2022-02-08
license GNU GPL v3 or later (LICENSE.md in that tree)

Vendored files are the original `js/*.js` with the sandbox seams applied
in place (seeded randInt, hexHistory instead of window.history, no
analytics / score phone-home / remote a.js, native keyboard instead of
keypress.js, FontAwesome play-glyph drawn as a triangle, high scores
through HT.ls* instead of localStorage). Images for pause / resume /
restart / help / back are the original SVGs.

Not shipped: jQuery, keypress, hammer, js.cookie, jsonfn, sweet-alert,
rrssb, Font Awesome, Exo/Roboto webfonts, Google Analytics, AdSense,
app-store badges, social share.
